_notes.embedder: local = on-device Transformers.js (zero egress, $0). none = keyword-only (no install needed). api:<provider> reserved for a future opt-in.
_notes.forbidSensitivePersistence: v1 decision: sensitive content is NOT encrypted; it is REFUSED. Keep real secrets in your OS store / password manager, never in a memory note.
_notes.external: Existing brain files are INGESTED read-only as searchable chunks. They are never copied or duplicated into entries/.
